Homebrew: a mechanical duplicate of the real Chain Lightning spell (damage, save, range, target, heightening all unchanged), renamed and reflavored as this character's Weredragon breath weapon.

You exhale a crackling torrent of draconic electrical breath at the target, dealing 8d12 electricity damage. The target must attempt a basic Reflex save. Residual arcs of the breath's energy leap to another creature within 30 feet of the first target, then to another creature within 30 feet of that one, and so on. You can end the chain at any point. You can't target the same creature more than once, and you must have line of effect to all targets. Roll the damage only once, and apply it to each target (halving or doubling as appropriate for its saving throw outcome). The chain ends if any one of the targets critically succeeds at its save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.

target.value: 1 creature, plus any number of additional creatures
